plain: Reading about yawning makes people yawn. A scientist measured it! The classic theory? You need oxygen. Nope. In nineteen eighty-seven, Robert Provine had people breathe pure oxygen, and they kept yawning! Five minutes of yawning faces? Fifty-five percent of people yawned! Reading about hiccups? Eleven. And there's no such thing as half a yawn.

Fifty-five percent of people yawned! [teasing] Reading about hiccups? [dry] Eleven. [conspiratorial whisper] And there's no such thing... as half a yawn.
